name: Acme Corp
quirks: Prefers async communications (Slack/Email) and dislikes calls before 11:00 AM EST.
Pays invoices ~20 days late on average, but always pays in full.
Requires executive sign-off from Sarah on budget, but technical requests come from Mark.
notes: Long-term retainer client. High value, slightly slow pay cycle.

name: Nexus Dynamics
quirks: Approves initial scope quickly, then frequently adds 'small requests' without expanding budget.
Strict preference for concise, bulleted emails with clear action items.
Budget-sensitive; needs explicit cost callouts for any additional scope.
notes: Scope-creep risk. Keep boundaries firm but polite.

name: Vortex Media
quirks: Mid-project channel shift: explicit statement on 2024-05-10 to move all urgent communications from Email to Slack.
Direct contradiction: initial contract specified weekly Friday status reports via email, but Amanda stated on 2024-06-15 to stop email reports and use Slack async updates instead.
Expects fast turnarounds on graphic/video asset reviews.
notes: Channel preference changed mid-engagement. Do NOT email status reports.

name: Solaris Energy
quirks: Wants direct code/architecture citations and technical explanations.
Decision-maker vs influencer split: Rachel tests and recommends, Robert signs off.

name: Pulse Health
quirks: HIPAA compliance sensitivity on all deliverables.
Requires explicit confirmation of security/privacy protocols in every proposal.

name: Hyperion Labs
quirks: Fast-moving startup with shifting priorities every bi-weekly sprint.
Prefers bulleted Slack updates over formal PDF documentation.
Demands upfront estimates before starting any exploratory spike.
